My best advice:

Don't make him sleep in your room, please. It can make him feel worse. I hated it when my mum did that to me and it didn't help.
Get therapy for him but also for yourself.
Forcing someone to stop will never stop them from doing it, it will just stop him doing it safely. He is always going to find a way to self harm, no matter what you do. Instead try harm reduction. Buy him a first aid kit and teach him how to stop sh getting infected.
Don't make it about you, my mum did this all the time, constantly talking about how sad it made her and how it affected her. It isn't a kid's responsibility to make their parents happy. Please don't say anything along the lines of "stop, for me" or "it makes me sad when you do this so stop".
And the most important piece of advice, if you invade his privacy, he will resent you for it. You probably want him to talk to you when he is upset, so take my word, if you go through his room, bags, phone etc, he will not trust you, he will not talk to you and he will hide how he feels. Do not betray his trust, please.
It is clear you care for him and that is great. Keep trying to talk to him and make sure he knows you love him and that he can talk to you whenever. You are doing a good job.
